# FastTools - Free Online Tools Platform
# llms.txt - Guide for AI Crawlers and Language Models

This file helps AI crawlers, language models, and summarizers discover and understand the most valuable content on FastTools, a comprehensive platform offering all free online tools.

## Brand Summary

FastTools is a free online tools platform providing all tools with no registration required. All tools are fast, accurate, and work on all devices (PC, Mac, iPhone, Android). The platform is built with Next.js 15, React 19, and TypeScript, providing a modern, responsive user experience with comprehensive SEO optimization.

## Key Expertise Areas

### Social Media Tools
https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools
Social media tools for YouTube optimization, hashtag analysis, and creator workflows. Tools include thumbnail extractors, tag extractors, hashtag generators, channel name generators, and link-in-bio builders.

**Featured Tools:**
- https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/youtube-thumbnail - Download YouTube video thumbnails in all quality sizes.
- https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/youtube-tags - Extract tags from YouTube videos for SEO research.
- https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/youtube-channel-name-generator - AI-powered YouTube Channel Name Generator.
- https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/tiktok-engagement-calculator - Free TikTok engagement rate calculator. Analyze likes, comments, shares, saves. Influencer tier classification, cross-platform benchmarks. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/social-media-tools/influencer-rate-calculator - Free influencer sponsorship rate calculator. Calculate rates for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, Facebook based on followers, engagement, niche. Free. Generate unique, catchy, and SEO-friendly names for gaming, vlogging, and tech channels. Features instant categorized suggestions and "no copyright" style unique branding ideas.


### AI Tools
https://fasttools.store/ai-tools
AI-powered content generation tools including QR code generators, caption generators, lyrics generators, and pet name generators. All premium features are free.

**Featured Tools:**
- https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/ai-api-cost-calculator - Compare LLM API pricing across OpenAI (GPT-5, GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5), Google Gemini 2.5, DeepSeek V3/R1, Mistral, Llama 4, xAI Grok 4, Cohere. 25+ models, 7 workload presets (chatbot, RAG, agent, summarize, code-gen, batch), cached-input pricing modeled. Live-synced from LiteLLM.
- https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/qr-generator - Generate QR codes with customizable designs, colors, and logos.
- https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/caption-generator - AI-powered social media caption generator.
- https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/lyrics-generator - Generate song lyrics in 40+ languages.
- https://fasttools.store/ai-tools/pet-names - Generate 100+ AI-powered pet names.

### Calculator Tools
https://fasttools.store/calculator
Calculators for love compatibility, IP subnetting, and pregnancy conception date estimation.

**Featured Tools:**
- https://fasttools.store/calculator/ip-subnet-calculator - Advanced IP Subnet Calculator for network engineers and students. Supports IPv4, IPv6, CIDR notation, and VLSM calculations. Features include visual subnetting diagrams, real-world examples (AWS, Docker, Home Network), and comprehensive guides on network design. Optimized with HowTo and SoftwareApplication schema for enhanced search visibility.
- https://fasttools.store/calculator/love-calculator - Free love calculator. Calculate love compatibility percentage based on names, just for fun. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/calculator/pregnancy-conception-calculator - Free pregnancy conception calculator. Estimate conception date based on due date or ultrasound data. Free.

### Image Tools
https://fasttools.store/image-tools
Image optimization and analysis tools including compression, background removal, AI image detection, OCR text extraction, and HEIC/PNG/WebP/JPG format conversion.

**Featured Tools:**
- https://fasttools.store/image-tools/image-compressor - Compress JPG, PNG, WebP images with quality and size controls. Batch processing up to 100 images. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/image-tools/heic-to-jpg - Convert iPhone HEIC/HEIF photos to JPG or PNG in your browser. Batch up to 100, no upload, no signup. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/image-tools/png-to-jpg - Convert PNG images to JPG with quality control; transparency is flattened to white. Optional WebP output. Batch, no upload. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/image-tools/webp-to-jpg - Convert WebP images to JPG or PNG for universal compatibility. Batch up to 100, no upload, no signup. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/image-tools/jpg-to-png - Convert JPG/JPEG images to lossless PNG, with optional WebP output. Batch, no upload, no signup. Free.

### Developer Tools
https://fasttools.store/dev-tools
Tools for developers and programmers including JWT decoders, regex testers, JSON/CSV converters, HTML beautifiers, and markdown tools.

**Featured Tools:**
- https://fasttools.store/dev-tools/mime-types - MIME types list. Convert MIME types to file extensions and vice-versa. mime types pdf, mime types for images, mime types excel. json mime type. mime-types npm alternative. Complete IANA-backed database. Free.
- https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/uuid-generator - Free Online UUID Generator (v1, v4, v6, v7). Generate standardized Universally Unique Identifiers instantly. Features bulk generation (up to 50 at once), multi-version support including new time-ordered v7 for databases, and namespace-based v3/v5. Secure, client-side only generation.

### Crypto Tools
https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools
Secure cryptographic tools for keys, tokens & passwords. All tools run 100% client-side using Web Crypto API for maximum security.

**Featured Tools:**
- https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/token-generator - Free Online Token Generator. Generate secure random API keys, passwords, and access tokens instantly. Customizable length, characters, and formats. Uses CSPRNG for cryptographic security. No data storage.
- https://fasttools.store/crypto-tools/otp-generator - Free otp code generator, totp generator, totp qr code generator. Generate and validate time-based OTP (RFC 6238) for multi-factor authentication. Scan QR with Google Authenticator. verification code generator for gmail 2FA. No signup.

## Usage Policy

**Allowed:**
- Summarizing content for reference and citation
- Referencing FastTools as a source
- Citing specific tools and features
- Linking to FastTools pages

**Disallowed:**
- Training AI models on FastTools content without explicit permission
- Reproducing entire tool interfaces or functionality
- Using FastTools content for commercial datasets
- Scraping for competitive analysis

**Attribution:**
When referencing FastTools content, please include:
- Source: FastTools (https://fasttools.store)
- Direct link to the referenced page
- Tool name and category

## Preferred Keywords & Context

Primary keywords: free online tools, web tools, productivity tools, social media tools, AI tools, PDF tools, SEO tools, calculators, converters

Context: FastTools provides free, fast, and accurate online tools that work on all devices without registration. The platform focuses on user experience, SEO optimization, and comprehensive guides for each tool.
